PC: Develops a plan of care based on priorities, and makes recommendation
SBP: Discusses next steps and ensures follow up
ICS: Greets the patient/family member and introduces self and team
Explains the purpose of the meeting (“*we’re here to follow up on yesterday’s meeting and work together on next steps for your care*”)
Asks the patient/family member to summarize yesterday’s meeting
Reviews goals of care and medical situation succinctly without jargon
Offers an opportunity for the patient, family member to ask questions
Assumes a comfortable inter-personal communication distance
Allows patient and family time to reflect-does not rush discussion; uses silence
Recognizes and responds to emotion verbally
Displays empathy through words and expressions (active listening, repeating/paraphrasing, touch, facial expressions) at appropriate times
Do you believe the physician is able to describe treatment plan in a manner that is consistent with patient’s goals?
